mapper.sql: id, server_id, metric, operator, threshold_value, level, confirm_count, notify_email, notify_dingtalk, notify_webhook, enabled, deleted, deleted_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alert_rules (server_id, metric, operator, threshold_value, level, confirm_count, notify_email, notify_dingtalk, notify_webhook, enabled, created_by) VALUES (#{rule.serverId}, #{rule.metric}, #{rule.operator}, #{rule.thresholdValue}, #{rule.level}, #{rule.confirmCount}, #{rule.notifyEmail}, #{rule.notifyDingtalk}, #{rule.notifyWebhook}, #{rule.enabled}, #{rule.createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM alert_rules WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM alert_rules WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM alert_rules WHERE deleted = 0 AND enabled = 1 AND (server_id = #{serverId} OR server_id IS NULL) ORDER BY server_id DESC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE alert_rules SET threshold_value = #{thresholdValue}, level = #{level}, enabled = #{enabled}, confirm_count = COALESCE(#{confirmCount}, confirm_count), notify_email = #{notifyEmail}, notify_dingtalk = #{notifyDingtalk}, notify_webhook = #{notifyWebhook} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
